(2) Extend the eval-quality pre-flight with an unsatisfiability lint: for each authored predicate, detect the positive-primitive-with-absence-intent shape (e.g. the failure detail text or expectation naming 'missing'/'absent'/'not contain' while using a Contains-family primitive) and WARN/BLOCK at authoring time, before dispatch.
